description: This file defines a C# interface for an Orleans grain, specifying asynchronous methods for tracking activation/deactivation calls and clearing/recording them.

classes.name: IActivateDeactivateWatcherGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that tracks activation and deactivation calls, extending Orleans' IGrainWithIntegerKey interface.

methods.name: GetActivateCalls
methods.description: Returns a list of activation call identifiers.

methods.name: GetDeactivateCalls
methods.description: Returns a list of deactivation call identifiers.

methods.name: RecordActivateCall
methods.description: Records an activation call with the given identifier.

methods.name: RecordDeactivateCall
methods.description: Records a deactivation call with the given identifier.
